title: Victoria Square aerial image, Christchurch, 1975
credit: Land Information New Zealand, New Zealand Aerial Mapping, New Zealand Aerial Surveys and the Royal New Zealand Air Force; via Wikimedia Commons.
altText: An aerial image of Victoria Square in Christchurch, circa 1975.
caption: Victoria Square, Christchurch, in an aerial image from 1975.
context: This 1975 aerial image predates the Te Maari eruption and was not part of the 2012 UAV survey described here. It provides an earlier aerial-imaging comparison.
